label: SECOND-AGENT TECHNICAL AUDIT - NOT ORGANIZATIONALLY INDEPENDENT

findings.title: Binance OI unit and bucket aggregation function are undocumented
findings.detail: The frozen route family (futures/data/openInterestHist) returns sumOpenInterest and sumOpenInterestValue per bucket. Neither the unit of sumOpenInterest (contracts vs base) nor the aggregation function (last vs average) is documented in the repository. A normalizer that selects one would invent semantics.
findings.expected_behaviour: Emit OI_UNIT_UNVERIFIED with the native values preserved and oi_usd blocked; do not select a single canonical native quantity.

findings.title: Funding interval is not carried by every reviewed route
findings.detail: Bybit funding history does not return the interval; Kraken's analytics route returns a sampled series whose sample interval is not the funding interval. Defaulting either to 8h would produce an interval-substitution error (8x or 1x misstatement).
findings.expected_behaviour: Refuse FUNDING_INTERVAL_UNVERIFIED unless interval evidence exists per instrument and time; keep the native rate and effective time.

findings.title: No reviewed free route publishes a provider-native book metric
findings.detail: The frozen contract permits provider-native spread/liquidity/slippage metrics as T1 evidence. Across Binance, Gate, Deribit, OKX, Bybit and Kraken free documentation reviewed here, only bid/ask and volume fields are published, from which a metric would be derived. A derived metric must therefore carry a registered methodology and must not claim provider nativity. DEPTH_BPS_RECONSTRUCTION_V1 exists in the methodology registry but is PROVISIONAL and unadmitted.
findings.expected_behaviour: Record MECHANICAL_BOOK_METRIC rows as Fabric-defined with methodology and lineage, or refuse them; never label a derived spread as provider-native.

findings.title: No provider-native basis; positioning populations are not interchangeable
findings.detail: No reviewed route publishes a basis field, so a basis is always derived and must name MARK vs INDEX. Positioning ratios differ by population (top-trader accounts vs all accounts vs positions), so equal field names do not establish comparability. Cross-venue basis synthesis is forbidden at T1.
findings.expected_behaviour: Refuse BASIS_REFERENCE_UNVERIFIED and POSITIONING_POPULATION_UNVERIFIED; refuse cross-venue basis and cross-provider ratio equivalence.

findings.title: No first-party captured payload bytes are retained in the repository
findings.detail: Bloc 2 capability evidence is existence/metadata level (E0_CLAIM_ONLY, E4_MULTI_ERA_VERIFIED, 'SOURCE_AVAILABILITY_VERIFIED only'). Bloc 3 network-smoke evidence records HTTP status, row counts and raw_content_hash but not payload bytes. Therefore no fixture can be a captured provider record, and no fixture in this corpus can be ratified as golden evidence without fabricating the payload.
findings.expected_behaviour: Retain one captured payload per (provider, sensor family, instrument) with SHA-256, endpoint, request fingerprint and acquisition time, before I20 ratification.

findings.title: No lineage package and no deterministic T1 identity
findings.detail: normalization/lineage does not exist, T1 records carry no id field, and normalization_generation is a caller-supplied passthrough. Only 2 of 8 sensor families are implemented.
findings.expected_behaviour: Do not claim LINEAGE_GATE. Close it only after I12-I15 publish and a content-addressed id exists.

findings.title: B5_I08_UNITS_V1 is absent from the methodology registry, so every *_usd stays blocked
findings.detail: The registry holds 9 methodology ids, all PROVISIONAL, and B5_I08_UNITS_V1 is not among them. The executable trade normalizer therefore blocks notional_usd with unresolved_citation=B5_I08_UNITS_V1 and raises UNIT_CONVERSION_BLOCKED plus STABLECOIN_CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE where a stablecoin quote is present. This matches the documented UNIT_GATE state and is verified as a positive control, not a defect.
findings.expected_behaviour: Keep oi_usd and any rate-based USD figure blocked until the operator admits the units methodology.

findings.title: Published families hold every independent control
findings.detail: 20/20 fixture assertions and 10/10 property controls passed through the real entry points, including native-value survival, no-authority canonical refusal, stablecoin non-parity, position/execution separation, null-not-zero and byte-identical output across hash seeds and timezones.
findings.expected_behaviour: Preserve; I12-I15 must inherit these laws.

findings.title: Sequence-gap fixture interface proposed, no block issued
findings.detail: The 8-case matrix is normalizer-agnostic and contains no code dependency. Consuming it needs a snapshot cursor, an ordered update list with (U,u,pu) or (seq,prevSeq), and an explicit recovery-snapshot argument with an authorization reference. No Agent 1 process was stopped for documentation work.
findings.expected_behaviour: Adopt or adjust the interface when I14 publishes; the expectations are frozen-vocabulary refusals, not new semantics.

findings.title: The audit-r4 carrier's production tree trails the accepted candidate
findings.detail: Cutting the Wave 1 branch from a59fa4002 produced a production tree differing from 66200f3cb in nine files: normalization/consumer/custody_authority.py, normalization/consumer/policy.py, and seven P3 consumer/replay test modules. The audit lineage forked before the candidate's F4/F5 repairs, and the audit commits themselves carry only evidence. The probe-relevant modules are identical on both trees.
findings.expected_behaviour: Publish evidence on a carrier whose production tree equals the accepted candidate, and disclose the divergence rather than silently correcting it.
findings.resolution: Evidence re-based on 96f4cd28e (production tree byte-identical to 66200f3cb) and the harness re-run; all seven result artifacts reproduced byte-for-byte. Prior audit branch preserved unchanged.

non_claims: no claim that any I12-I15 behaviour is correct
no production, test or manifest change
